events.bon-clay-friendship: The ship runs into Mr. 2 Bon Clay, who befriends the Straw Hats.
events.ace-reunion: Ace, a commander of the Whitebeard Pirates, stops Smoker and reunites with Luffy.
events.luffy-vs-vivi-yuba: Luffy fights Vivi in Yuba and forces her to admit she cannot save the country without putting anyone at risk.
events.crocodile-unmasked-rain-dinners: Crocodile traps the Straw Hats in Rain Dinners and reveals Operation Utopia.
events.luffy-vs-crocodile-round-1: First fight: Crocodile dries Luffy out and leaves him half dead in the desert.
events.usopp-chopper-vs-mr4-miss-merry-christma: Usopp and Chopper defeat Mr. 4 and Miss Merry Christmas.
events.sanji-vs-mr2-bon-clay: Sanji beats Mr. 2 Bon Clay and his Okama Kenpo.
events.nami-vs-miss-doublefinger: Nami defeats Miss Doublefinger with the Clima-Tact.
events.cobra-reveals-pluton: Cobra confirms that Crocodile is after the ancient weapon Pluton.
events.zoro-vs-mr1: Zoro learns to cut steel and beats Mr. 1 with Shishi Sonson.
events.water-luffy: Luffy soaks himself in water so he can hit Crocodile's sand body.
events.luffy-vs-crocodile-round-2: Second fight: Water Luffy lands hits on Crocodile but falls, pierced by his hook.
events.pell-carries-the-bomb: Pell flies off with the bomb from Alubarna's plaza and it explodes in the sky.
events.luffy-defeats-crocodile: Luffy defeats Crocodile in the third fight and rain returns to Alabasta.
events.bon-clay-decoy: Bon Clay sacrifices himself so the Straw Hats can escape the Marine blockade.
events.vivi-farewell-x-mark: Vivi says goodbye from the dock and the crew raises their arms bearing the X mark.
events.nico-robin-joins-straw-hats: Nico Robin appears aboard the Going Merry and asks to join the crew.
